claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Terbinafine is a fungal squalene epoxidase inhibitor with no meaningful activity against human SQLE at 2.5 uM, so it is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Terbinafine is a fungal squalene epoxidase inhibitor with no meaningful activity against human SQLE at 2.5 uM, so it is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines.
